# Kearsley & Co Gas Services

> Gas Safe registered plumbers and gas engineers based in Yeadon, Leeds. Domestic, commercial and industrial work — boiler installation and servicing, general plumbing, gas safety, and air conditioning installation. Fast response, no call-out charges.

Kearsley & Co Gas Services serves Yeadon, Guiseley, Rawdon, Horsforth and the wider Leeds area. The company is Gas Safe registered and a Worcester Bosch approved installer, also fitting Vaillant, Samsung, LG and Hitachi equipment.

Contact: info@kearsleygs.co.uk · 01943 662713
Address: Yeadon, Leeds, LS19, UK

## Services

- [Plumbing](https://www.kearsleygs.co.uk/plumbing): General plumbing repairs and installations.
- [Gas Services](https://www.kearsleygs.co.uk/gas-services): Gas Safe boiler installation, servicing and repairs, Worcester Bosch installer.
- [Air Conditioning](https://www.kearsleygs.co.uk/air-conditioning): Air conditioning installation and servicing (Worcester Bosch, Samsung, LG, Hitachi).
